summary: Empty or non-Unicode USERPROFILE yields a misleading path or empty string; empty value produces \\Downloads, rejected as invalid target
evidence: files.rs:9-11 trim and format with no check; files.rs:14-18 .ok() swallows NotUnicode and unset alike
failure_scenario: USERPROFILE="" -> default target \\Downloads -> invalidTarget error instead of profile-unknown message. Extends FND-0028.
